name: Etapp 10: STF Njunjes Fjällstuga - STF Kvikkjokk Fjällstation
to: STF Kvikkjokk Fjällstation via Bobäcken boat landing
description: STF Njunjes Fjällstuga to STF Kvikkjokk Fjällstation via Bobäcken boat landing. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: Kvikkjokk restaurant, café, bar, shop and rental (food)
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Route geometry is the Njunjes-to-Bobäcken walking leg. The usual Bobäcken-Kvikkjokk finish is a boat transfer and current operator details must be checked.

facilities.name: Bobäcken boat landing
facilities.description: Boat landing and de facto southern Padjelantaleden walking endpoint. Normal route requires boat to/from Kvikkjokk.

facilities.name: Bobäcken boat-order phone
facilities.coordinateSource: Shelter/landing proxy; Naturkartan describes phone for boat ordering.
facilities.description: Phone at/near Bobäcken rest cabin for ordering boat transport. Treat as access metadata, not as an emergency phone, until 2026 operation is verified.

facilities.name: Bobäcken Raststuga
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 10197762556, cross-checked with Vindskyddskartan coordinate 66.94517813, 17.65455498 and Naturkartan Bobäcken page.
facilities.description: Rest cabin/stopover shelter at the Bobäcken walking endpoint and boat landing area. Facilities lane reports capacity 10, toilet and seasonal boat route; no stove, no mountain waste handling, and overnighting only for emergencies.

facilities.name: Kvikkjokk boat terminal
facilities.description: Kvikkjokk-side boat terminal for the Bobäcken/Padjelantaleden transfer.

facilities.name: STF Kvikkjokk Fjällstation
facilities.coordinateSource: STF/Kvikkjokk Fjällstation coordinate, cross-checked with Padjelanta.se and OSM.
facilities.description: Official stage endpoint and service gateway with lodging, food service, shop/provisions/outdoor supplies, rental, showers/toilets for paying users, self-catering kitchen, road access, bus connections and nearby parking. Check 2026 renovation/service status before relying on it.

facilities.name: Kvikkjokk restaurant, café, bar, shop and rental
facilities.coordinateSource: Attached to STF Kvikkjokk Fjällstation coordinate; OSM restaurant at 66.9538099, 17.7195389 nearby.
facilities.description: Gateway services at STF Kvikkjokk: restaurant, café/bar, shop/provisions, outdoor supplies and rental. Current service scope is seasonal and affected by 2026 renovation notes; Check before travel.

facilities.name: Kvikkjokk parking near fjällstation
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM way 38072855 approximate center; STF/Kvikkjokk gateway context.
facilities.description: Gateway parking near Kvikkjokk Fjällstation. There is no road or parking at Njunjes or Bobäcken.

facilities.name: Njunjes safety room and help phone
facilities.coordinateSource: Attached to STF Njunjes hut coordinate; STF says the storehouse contains the safety room/help phone but no separate coordinate was found.
facilities.description: Safety room/help phone at STF Njunjes. Attach to hut unless standalone emergency-phone/safety-room POIs are supported.

facilities.name: STF Njunjes Fjällstuga
facilities.coordinateSource: STF GPS coordinate; Padjelanta.se and OSM hut way center nearby.
facilities.description: STF hut at the stage start above Tarraätno, with two 10-bed rooms, kitchen/sleeping alcoves, safety room/help phone in the storehouse, limited pet room, card/Swish possible if Telia coverage works, and relatively good Telia GSM.
